subject.title: Feature request: Per-channel tool call budget with auto-delegation

question: Should OpenClaw add a core per-channel tool-call budget, and which overflow modes should be in scope before automatic sub-agent delegation?
rationale: The request adds user-visible config, runtime enforcement, channel policy precedence, and child-session authority rules that cannot be chosen safely by cleanup automation.

options.title: Stage warn/block first
options.body: Add scoped budget resolution and deterministic warn/block behavior, then defer auto-delegation until child authority and handoff rules are designed.

options.title: Design full auto-delegation
options.body: Specify budget enforcement, child-session creation, inherited tools, sandbox requirements, and parent summary delivery before any implementation starts.

options.title: Defer core budget surface
options.body: Keep this as an open design topic and steer operators to existing tool policy and explicit sessions_spawn guidance for now.

recommendation.title: Stage warn/block first
recommendation.body: Add scoped budget resolution and deterministic warn/block behavior, then defer auto-delegation until child authority and handoff rules are designed.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent keep-open design comment and has the strongest current history across before-tool hooks, loop detection, and subagent docs.
